name: zalando-mcp
description: Zalando Partner Program (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_o

platform_mcp_zalando_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_zalando_client_id.description: Client ID of an app registered in the zDirect (Zalando Partner) portal > Applications, with the stocks, prices, orders and offer-blocker scopes granted.

platform_mcp_zalando_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_zalando_client_secret.description: Client secret of the same app; sent with the client ID as HTTP Basic on POST https://api.merchants.zalando.com/auth/token.

platform_mcp_zalando_merchant_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_MERCHANT_ID
platform_mcp_zalando_merchant_id.description: Your zDirect merchant id (uuid; GET /auth/me lists the merchant ids the token can access).

platform_mcp_zalando_sales_channel_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_SALES_CHANNEL_ID
platform_mcp_zalando_sales_channel_id.description: Sales channel id (uuid) the offers belong to (Sales Channels API); each Zalando country shop is a channel.

platform_mcp_zalando_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ZALANDO_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_zalando_currency.description: ISO currency of the sales channel, e.g. EUR; required for update_listing.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /auth/me: the token owner's scopes and the merchant ids it can access.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Prices API POST /merchants/{merchant-id}/prices {product_prices: [{ean, sales_channel_id, regular_price: {amount, currency}}]} sets the LIVE regular price of the offer (listing_id = the article EAN) in the configured sales channel. Only the price is applied (`price` required). Answers 207 with a per-item status.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: Stocks API POST /merchants/{merchant-id}/stocks {items: [{sales_channel_id, ean, quantity}]}: `sku` must be the article EAN (GTIN-13). Answers 207 with a per-item result.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: Article Availability (Offer Blocking) API: creates a pause blocker for the EAN in the configured sales channel with reason PAUSE_06 ('Other reasons'), taking the offer offline; delete the blocker (DELETE /offer-blockers) to reactivate. Needs the products/blockers/write scope.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Orders API GET /merchants/{merchant-id}/orders?order_status(initial|approved|fulfilled)&created_after(ISO-8601)&page[number]&page[size] for the configured sales channel (JSON:API). `id` is the order id (uuid) used by mark_shipped; raw.attributes.order_number is the customer-facing number.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: PATCH /merchants/{merchant-id}/orders/{order-id} {data: {type: Order, id, attributes: {tracking_number}}} records the tracking number. Marking lines shipped is a separate per-order-line PATCH ({type: OrderLine, attributes: {status: shipped}}) that this tool does not make; `carrier` is not a field of the order.
